analysis_type: Retrospective robustness analysis of saved evaluations, not a preregistered study
aggregation: Mean repeated ratings within Q&A, then mean Q&As within video/version, then equal-weight mean matched video differences
bootstrap: Paired video-cluster percentile bootstrap, stratified by Master and Teepa, preserving source counts
permutation: Two-sided paired video-block label-swap test for primary outcomes only
primary_multiple_testing: Holm correction across exactly two primary outcomes
secondary_tests: Descriptive estimates and unadjusted confidence intervals only; no additional p-values
interpretation: Conditional on the observed generated Q&As and saved judge runs. Does not establish human accuracy, noninferiority, or causal effects of a single prompt instruction.
